# Perpenda

> Decision-grade fluency in LLM systems, for product managers. Perpenda is a focused Android reader that teaches senior PMs to make build / buy / skip calls on AI features — one trade-off at a time. Twenty units in one curated order, calibrated grading against rubric criteria. No streaks, no badges, no daily nudge.

Perpenda is an independent product, built in Lisbon, Portugal, and released under GPL-3.0. The path "LLM Systems for PMs" is built to reach twenty units; fifteen are published, and the final five are shaped during the closed beta rather than planned in advance. Every claim is sourced and tagged by calibration tier — settled, contested, or unsettled — with sources placed after the decision prompt so consensus doesn't prime the answer.

## Core

- [Home](https://perpenda.com/): Product overview — the thesis (a trade-off, not a topic), the curated path, the two core app screens, and the calibration approach.
- [Marginalia (notes / blog)](https://perpenda.com/blog/): Notes in the margins of building Perpenda — LLM systems, product judgment, and what's worth a PM's attention. In English, and in Portuguese where it serves Portuguese readers.

## Writing

- [Amy Edmondson at QSP 2026: a primer for product managers](https://perpenda.com/blog/qsp-2026-amy-edmondson.html): Why the researcher behind psychological safety and intelligent failure is the most operationally useful QSP Summit 2026 speaker for teams shipping AI products. With a Portuguese summary.
- [Virginia Dignum at QSP 2026: responsible AI beyond the checkbox](https://perpenda.com/blog/qsp-2026-virginia-dignum.html): What Virginia Dignum's work on AI governance and the EU AI Act means for product teams shipping AI. With a Portuguese version.

## Legal

- [Privacy policy](https://perpenda.com/legal/privacy-policy.html): What data the app collects, how it's used, and how to delete it. No advertising SDKs, no behavioural analytics.
- [Account deletion](https://perpenda.com/legal/account-deletion.html): How to delete your account and associated data.
